استنجدن (form X)

# اُسْتُنْجِدْنَ (ustunjidna) /us.tun.d͡ʒid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اِسْتَنْجِدْنَ (istanjidna) /is.tan.d͡ʒid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
